name: Smart Trend Follower
summary: This EA is a trend-following martingale system that uses either MA crossover or MA+Stochastic confirmation to generate trade signals. On losing positions, it opens additional layers at fixed pip distances with multiplied lot sizes (martingale), then sets a common break-even TP/SL across all positions of the same direction.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个趋势跟踪马丁格尔系统，使用MA交叉或MA+随机指标确认来生成交易信号。在亏损头寸上，以固定点距间隔开立额外层级并乘以手数（马丁格尔），然后对同方向所有持仓设置统一的保本止盈/止损。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于趋势跟踪，提供两种入场信号模式：一种是双MA交叉（快MA上穿慢MA做多，下穿做空），另一种是MA趋势方向确认加上随机指标超卖/超买区域过滤和K线方向确认。出场条件采用所有同方向持仓的加权平均保本价加上固定点数的统一止盈，止损可选。仓位管理采用马丁格尔策略，首仓使用初始手数，后续每层按乘数倍增手数（默认2倍），层间距固定为200点。资金管理方面有手数规范化、最小手数限制、最大手数限制、手数步长对齐以及保证金检查，但没有整体风险敞口限制。该EA在每个新K线时检测信号，持续修改所有持仓的TP/SL以保持统一出场目标。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following with two entry signal modes: one is dual MA crossover (fast MA crossing above slow MA for buy, below for sell), and the other uses MA trend direction confirmation combined with Stochastic oversold/overbought zone filtering and candle direction confirmation. Exit conditions use a weighted average break-even price across all same-direction positions plus a fixed pip take-profit, with optional stop-loss. Position sizing employs a martingale approach where the first position uses the initial lot size, and each subsequent layer multiplies the lot by a configurable multiplier (default 2x), with layers spaced at a fixed 200-pip distance. Money management includes lot normalization, minimum/maximum lot limits, lot step alignment, and margin checking, but lacks overall risk exposure limits. The EA detects signals on each new candle and continuously modifies TP/SL for all positions to maintain a unified exit target.

parameters.description_en: Martingale multiplier, lot scaling factor per layer

pros: 提供两种入场信号模式，MA交叉和MA+随机指标趋势确认，增加策略灵活性
包含完善的保证金检查和手数规范化逻辑，防止无效下单
统一管理同方向持仓的TP/SL，基于加权平均保本价计算，逻辑清晰
pros_en: Provides two entry signal modes (MA crossover and MA+Stochastic trend confirmation), adding strategy flexibility
Includes thorough margin checking and lot normalization logic to prevent invalid orders
Unified TP/SL management for same-direction positions based on weighted average break-even price, with clear logic
cons: 马丁格尔策略风险极高，连续加仓会导致手数指数级增长，可能快速爆仓
默认止损为0，在没有止损的情况下马丁格尔加仓，风险不可控
getTotalVolume函数中存在bug，对挂单使用了PositionGetDouble而非OrderGetDouble获取手数
CopyBuffer没有检查返回值，指标数据读取失败时会导致错误信号
cons_en: Martingale strategy carries extreme risk; consecutive layering causes exponential lot growth that can rapidly blow the account
Default stop-loss is 0, meaning martingale positions accumulate without any safety net, making risk uncontrollable
Bug in getTotalVolume: uses PositionGetDouble instead of OrderGetDouble for pending orders volume
CopyBuffer return values are not checked, so failed indicator data reads can produce wrong signals
improvements: 强制要求设置止损，或添加最大层数限制以控制马丁格尔风险敞口
修复getTotalVolume中对挂单使用PositionGetDouble的bug，应改为OrderGetDouble，并检查CopyBuffer返回值
添加最大回撤保护机制，当浮亏达到账户余额一定比例时强制平仓
improvements_en: Mandate a stop-loss or add a maximum layer count limit to control martingale risk exposure
Fix the getTotalVolume bug using OrderGetDouble for pending orders instead of PositionGetDouble, and check CopyBuffer return values
Add maximum drawdown protection that forces position closure when floating loss reaches a configurable percentage of account balance

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略手数指数增长，连续加仓可快速耗尽账户资金
默认止损为0，多层加仓后无止损保护，单边行情可能导致巨大亏损
无最大加仓层数限制，极端行情下风险敞口无上限
risk_points_en: Martingale lot sizing grows exponentially; consecutive layering can rapidly deplete account funds
Default stop-loss of 0 means multi-layer positions have no protection, and a sustained trend can cause massive losses
No maximum layer count limit means risk exposure is unbounded in extreme market conditions

On losing positions, it opens additional layers at fixed pip distances with multiplied lot sizes (martingale), then sets a common break-even TP/SL across all positions of the same direction.
